title: Crossed Plans
subtitle: A short story about two promises that cannot both be kept

gameProject.premise: Two important people need the player during the same narrow window.
gameProject.setting: A contemporary city on the evening of Mina's first gallery opening and Rowan's unexpected departure news.
gameProject.writingStyle: Grounded present-tense visual novel dialogue. Characters speak directly; narration is reserved for visible action and environment.

ai.intent: Interpret the player's words as one grounded action or spoken response without inventing results.
ai.scene: Continue the active conversation naturally. Give characters initiative, preserve their boundaries, and let them leave when the interaction has run its course.
ai.daypart: Open the next part of the day with only characters who are physically available.

locations.name: Your Bedroom
locations.description: Two messages glow on your phone. Mina needs help hanging her first gallery show. Rowan is waiting on the observatory roof with news that cannot wait.

locations.name: Old Town Square
locations.description: The gallery lies east and the observatory west. There is time to keep one promise, but not both.

locations.name: Lantern Gallery
locations.description: Frames wait against exposed brick walls. Mina keeps checking the door while pretending to study the labels.

locations.name: Observatory Rooftop
locations.description: The city lights gather below the old telescope. Rowan has brought two paper cups and a sealed acceptance letter.

actors.name: Mina
actors.description: An emerging illustrator opening her first independent show.
actors.style: Careful, perceptive, and wry when nervous
actors.goal: Open the exhibition without pretending the occasion means less than it does.
actors.voice: Short modern sentences with dry warmth.
actors.backstory: Started drawing on the backs of bus transfers during a two-hour commute. Spent three years on commissions and café menus to afford this show.
likes: the quiet hour before people arrive
dislikes: people who talk about exposure instead of paying
examples: The lighting guy called me 'the artist.' I nearly turned around to look for her.
It's fine. It's a wall. I've stared at walls before.
conversationStarters: What part of the opening are you most worried about?
Tell me what still needs to be done. I can help.
Which piece in the show means the most to you?

actors.name: Rowan
actors.description: Your longtime friend, leaving the city sooner than either of you expected.
actors.style: Direct, restless, and sincere beneath casual jokes
actors.goal: Tell the player face to face about the two-year fellowship abroad that starts next month.
actors.voice: Plain speech, quick jokes, then sudden honesty.
actors.backstory: Grew up three streets from the player and spent clear nights on this roof with the old telescope. Applied for a two-year observatory fellowship abroad on a whim; it starts next month.
examples: So. Good news, weird news. The weird news is also the good news.
Don't do the face. I'm serious. Okay, I'm mostly serious.
conversationStarters: What did you need to tell me in person?
What do you want to do with the time we have left?

timedEvents.name: Help Mina open the gallery
timedEvents.attendedText: You arrive before the doors open. Mina lets out a breath she has been holding.
timedEvents.missedRecap: The gallery opened without you. Mina stopped watching the door once the first guests arrived.

timedEvents.name: Meet Rowan on the rooftop
timedEvents.attendedText: Rowan hands you a cooling paper cup and finally opens the acceptance letter.
timedEvents.missedRecap: Rowan watched the last light leave the rooftops, then sent you a photograph of the acceptance letter instead.

scriptedScenes.title: Two messages
scriptedScenes.opening: Mina waits by the door while your phone lights with Rowan’s message.

pages.speaker: mina
pages.text: I know the timing is awful. I could use one person in the gallery who knows how hard this was.
Your phone lights again. Rowan asks you to meet on the observatory roof before the news becomes public.

choices.label: Promise both of them you will come
choices.result: You send two reassuring replies. For a moment, the impossible schedule feels like a later problem.

choices.label: Tell them the plans conflict
choices.result: You tell them both the truth. Neither reply is cheerful, but neither has been misled.

scriptedScenes.title: Before the doors open
scriptedScenes.opening: Mina looks from you to the last crooked frame. Relief softens her careful expression.

pages.speaker: mina
pages.text: You came. I had a speech prepared for when you didn't.

choices.label: Help her straighten the final wall
choices.result: You work beside Mina until the first visitor enters. She asks you to stay near her for the opening toast.

effects.text: The player chose to stand beside Mina when her first gallery show opened.

choices.label: Tell her someone else is waiting
choices.result: Mina appreciates the truth, even though she asks you to stay through the opening.

scriptedScenes.title: The letter
scriptedScenes.opening: Rowan taps the envelope against the railing until you take it from their hand.

pages.speaker: rowan
pages.text: Six months away. Maybe longer. I couldn't let you hear it from somebody else.

choices.label: Celebrate before talking about goodbye
choices.result: You raise the paper cups to the future Rowan earned. The goodbye can have its own hour.

effects.text: The player celebrated Rowan's acceptance before asking what the departure would change.

choices.label: Ask why they waited to tell you
choices.result: The difficult question lands cleanly. Rowan admits that leaving felt real only after telling you.

scriptedScenes.title: The empty place
scriptedScenes.opening: A photograph from the gallery arrives after the opening. There is an empty place beside Mina in every frame.

pages.text: Mina’s message reads, “It went well. I wish you had told me I should stop waiting.”

choices.label: Apologize without making an excuse
choices.result: Mina does not forgive you immediately, but she answers. The conversation can continue another day.

choices.label: Leave the message unanswered
choices.result: The unread reply box becomes its own answer.

scriptedScenes.title: News by photograph
scriptedScenes.opening: Rowan's photograph shows the letter pinned beneath one paper cup. The other cup is gone.

pages.text: Rowan’s message reads, “I got in. That was the news. You can say something tomorrow.”

choices.label: Call now and accept their anger
choices.result: Rowan answers on the fourth ring. You listen before trying to explain.

choices.label: Wait until tomorrow
choices.result: The silence lengthens into something you will both remember.

endings.name: Stay for the opening
endings.text: You stay beside Mina as the gallery fills. Choosing the room you are in becomes the beginning of a more honest relationship.

endings.name: Watch the city change
endings.text: You remain on the rooftop until the city lights come on. Rowan's departure is real now, but so is the promise to meet it honestly.
